AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: Lantern.cs:21-28 gains `DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue` == 1 energy on the player side while `PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber <= 1`. The mapping is the executed one, not the docstring's: `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order` prints on_block_cleared -> on_energy_reset -> on_player_turn_start -> modify_hand_draw -> on_player_turn_started, and audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 23 is where the player-side AfterSideTurnStart sits -- both AFTER the energy reset (steps 17-18), which is what makes the +1 survive rather than being overwritten. hooks.py:285-295 names Lantern in that slot's own docstring and the executed order agrees. EXECUTED (py audit/tools/relic_probes_b08.py b08-lantern): turn 1 energy 3 -> 4 with the relic, turn 2 back to 3, exactly C#'s numbers. `participants.Contains(base.Owner.Creature)` is structurally satisfied (player-side-only dispatch), and `self.turn <= 1` matches TurnNumber <= 1 given the executed numbering (the first on_player_turn_started fires at turn=1 and turn is a positive counter, so there is no turn-0 case where the spellings differ) -- the same argument audit/records/relic/bag_of_preparation.json makes for its ModifyHandDraw. Rule 7: hooks.py and audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json are not hashed by this record.

guards.what: N1: `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(amount, player)` (Lantern.cs:26) vs `EnergyCmd.gain(self.hooks, player, 1)` (lantern.py:20-21) -- the missing AfterModifyingEnergyGain companion and the `finalAmount > 0` / `IsEnding` guards
guards.issue: PlayerCmd.GainEnergy does five things: bail on `amount <= 0`, bail on `CombatManager.Instance.IsEnding`, `Hook.ModifyEnergyGain(... out modifiers)`, `await Hook.AfterModifyingEnergyGain(state, modifiers)`, then `GainEnergy(finalAmount)` only when finalAmount > 0. EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py:545-554) does the modify chain and the add, and nothing else. Taken one at a time: the `amount <= 0` bail is unreachable (Lantern passes a pinned 1); the `finalAmount > 0` skip is equivalent because hooks.modify_energy_gain already clamps with `max(0, amount)` (hooks.py:215) and `+= 0` is a no-op -- EXECUTED, the only ported modify_energy_gain listener is powers.py:554 and the clamp is unconditional; the IsEnding guard is the combat-over guard family; and the missing AfterModifyingEnergyGain out-parameter/companion pair is the SAME family audit/records/relic/bag_of_preparation.json guard N1, audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 20 and audit/records/seam/power_cmd.json gap G4 all record for their own dispatchers -- one verdict per mechanism, binding rule 3. DORMANT at this site: Lantern itself implements no AfterModifyingEnergyGain (Lantern.cs declares only Rarity, CanonicalVars, ExtraHoverTips and AfterSideTurnStart), so none of ITS behaviour is lost; porting any model that implements the companion makes the energy hook's half live, exactly as bag_of_preparation records for the draw hook. Rule 7: cmds.py, hooks.py and powers.py are not hashed by this record.
